import sys

MOD = 998244353

def power_mod(b, e, m):
    return pow(b, e, m)

def process():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    L = int(data[2])
    R = int(data[3])

    inv2 = power_mod(2, MOD - 2, MOD)
    diff = R - L + 1
    p1 = diff // 2
    p2 = diff - p1
    nm = n * m

    if nm % 2 == 1:
        ans = power_mod(diff, nm, MOD)
    else:
        ans = (power_mod(diff, nm, MOD) + power_mod(abs(p1 - p2), nm, MOD)) % MOD
        ans = (ans * inv2) % MOD

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    process()
